facts.fact: 社区的互助口径是「互相照看而不互相照护」，不替对方承担照护责任
facts.anchor: look out for each other, not look after each other

facts.fact: 写作时全体成员比刚搬进来那年长九岁
facts.anchor: everyone is nine years older than when we first moved in

facts.fact: Sue T 在电梯外摔倒髋骨骨折，邻居围成一圈陪了五个小时直到救护车到
facts.anchor: They stayed with me for five hours until the ambulance came

facts.fact: 健康伙伴制按三到四人一组编队，是彼此健康事务的第一联系人
facts.anchor: Women form groups of three or four and are the first point of contact for each other in health-related situations

facts.fact: Aleth 心脏手术期间 OWCH 成员排班做饭陪走，估算为 NHS 省下约五千英镑善后开销
facts.anchor: we worked out it had saved the NHS around £5K in aftercare

facts.fact: Madeleine 基金由住户及其家人的捐款构成，用于医疗急事、换坏灶具、配镜与教育资源
facts.anchor: The pot of money, created from donations from residents and their families

facts.fact: Age UK 数据：约两百万七十五岁以上老人独居，其中过半说能一个月不与亲友邻居说话
facts.anchor: around 2 million people over the age of seventy-five live alone

facts.fact: 社区共二十六位女性，各自摸索在这个群体里的分寸
facts.anchor: there are twenty-six women finding their way
